text:
derek: quick sync after the last canary  i want a very small, auditable contract for fast fallbacks so operators can reason about what happened. no global state explosions.
mae: agree. runtime can protect locally but must emit a signed "fallback_claim" event immediately and then try to acquire a short-lived lease. orchestrator decides sustained state.
sylvia: signed event sounds heavy. can we instead emit a compact proof blob (json-lines) with aggregates + seed and a signature optional for operator audits? keep payload <1KB.
arthur: proposal for the minimal proof: {decision_id, cohort_id, window_ms, samples, p50_ms, p95_ms, error_rate, reason_code, score, seed_hash, actionability}. flat keys, short names.
derek: love it. reason_code enum: LAT_P99, SERVE_ERR, KVS_LAG, OOM, MODEL_DRIFT. no freeform.
mae: actionability enum: INFO, ACTIONABLE, EMERGENCY. runtime only auto-acts on ACTIONABLE/EMERGENCY. INFO is telemetry-only.
orch-bot: deploy: canary-run 2026-07-07T11:02Z started svc=inference-router rev=canary-x7.
sylvia: cooldowns: runtime local debounce 20-90s. orchestrator lease TTL 5-20m. runtime requests lease asynchronously; if lease denied, runtime must honor orchestrator decision.
arthur: precedence table simple: operator_override > orchestrator_lease > runtime_preempt_lease > transient_local_action. operator_override should be auditable and require human token.
derek: interface: SetFallback RPC for orchestrator->runtime (idempotent, mTLS). also GetLeaseStatus runtime->orchestrator. runtime posts proof to telemetry stream (kinesis) and also writes the lease request to the lease api.
mae: small simulation ask: build a deterministic harness that replays traffic and injects p99 spikes, kv lag, and OOM signals. deterministic seeds so tests reproducible.
sylvia: add burn-in/quorum rule for canaries: during first N minutes or first M requests, ACTIONABLE signals need quorum across AZs (default 3 AZs with >=2 instances) before orchestrator will grant a global lease. prevents single-instance noise.
arthur: action items: (1) sylvia + mae: draft json-lines schema + reason_code enum by Thu (2) derek: write SetFallback/GetLease proto sketch (gRPC) by Fri (3) mae: simulation harness skeleton and seed plan next week (4) sylvia: short operator doc describing precedence and how to override.
derek: tiny UX ask: telemetry should include a short human note field for triage links. optional, but searchable.
sylvia: agreed. also include cost_impact_bucket (0-5) optionally so orchestrator can weigh cost vs quality when auto-deciding.
orch-bot: alert: elevated fallback-rate for cohort=canary-x7 zone=eu-west-1 at 11:08Z.
mae: i'll start the telemetry PR with examples. keep lines compact for producers.
derek: ok thanks all. let's keep the runtime change minimal this cycle and iterate after sim results. closing thread.
